resources.title: A Sanskrit Primer
resources.author: Edward Delavan Perry, based on Georg Bühler
resources.description: A complete course with an introduction to the script, grammar lessons, vocabulary, and translation exercises. Begin with Alphabet and Sounds, then work through the first lessons at your own pace.
resources.rightsNote: La Trobe’s record identifies this edition as public domain with unrestricted access and use, and lists CC0.

resources.title: Sanskrit Grammar
resources.author: William Dwight Whitney
resources.description: A detailed reference to consult as questions arise. Start with Chapters I–II for the alphabet and pronunciation; return later for noun endings, verbs, and compounds.
resources.rightsNote: Wikisource marks Whitney’s original work as public domain. Its website interface and additional contributions have separate terms.
